info.description: Self-recorded answers: no independent implementation or published vector was available for these exports, so the addon's own output (after the 2026-10 audit, with strict aliasing off and every source linked) is recorded here to catch unintended change. A mismatch means the implementation changed, not that the new value is wrong — re-record on purpose only.
info.unverified_parameters: yespower_iots and yespower_mgpc declare a personalization length of 8 for longer strings, and yespower_litb a 73-byte string ending in "mini"; they are recorded as inherited from node-multi-hashing, not confirmed against the coins
info.cryptonightfast: fast = the second argument true (the fast variant), variant0/variant1 = the second argument 0 / 1
